contract.task_clause:
Which of the following is true as of 2020?
Option A: males are more likely to have depression and are more likely to have an alcohol use disorder than females.
Option B: females are more likely to have depression and are more likely to have an alcohol use disorder than males.
Option C: males are more likely than females to have depression while females are more likely than males to have an alcohol use disorder.
Option D: females are more likely than males to have depression while males are more likely than females to have an alcohol use disorder.
